arxiv-2301-01679.title: COVID-Net USPro: An Open-Source Explainable Few-Shot Deep Prototypical Network to Monitor and Detect COVID-19 Infection from Point-of-Care Ultrasound Images
arxiv-2301-01679.creator: Jessy Song, Ashkan Ebadi, Adrian Florea, Pengcheng Xi, Stéphane Tremblay, Alexander Wong
arxiv-2301-01679.description: Abstract As the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) continues to impact many aspects of life and the global healthcare systems, the adoption of rapid and effective screening methods to prevent further spread of the virus and lessen the burden on healthcare providers is a necessity.

arxiv-2302-11787.title: Empathetic Response Generation via Emotion Cause Transition Graph
arxiv-2302-11787.creator: Yushan Qian †‡♡ , Bo Wang †∗ , Ting-En Lin ‡ , Yinhe Zheng ‡ Ying Zhu † , Dongming Zhao † , Yuexian Hou † , Yuchuan Wu ‡ , Yongbin Li ‡∗
arxiv-2302-11787.description: Abstract Empathetic dialogue is a human-like behavior that requires the perception of both affective factors (e.g., emotion status) and cognitive factors (e.g., cause of the emotion). Besides concerning emotion status in early work, the latest approaches study emotion causes in empathetic dialogue. These approaches focus on understanding and duplicating emotion causes in the context to show empathy for the speaker.

arxiv-2305-16543.title: Revisiting Structured Variational Autoencoders
arxiv-2305-16543.creator: Yixiu Zhao, Scott W. Linderman
arxiv-2305-16543.description: Abstract Structured variational autoencoders (SVAEs) ( Johnson et al. 2016 ) combine probabilistic graphical model priors on latent variables, deep neural networks to link latent variables to observed data, and structure-exploiting algorithms for approximate posterior inference. These models are particularly appealing for sequential data, where the prior can capture temporal dependencies.

arxiv-2312-01024.title: Hybrid Quantum Neural Network in High-dimensional Data Classification Thanks: Manuscript
arxiv-2312-01024.creator: *1. Hao-Yuan Chen, 2. Yen-Jui Chang, 3. Shih-Wei Liao, 3. 4. Ching-Ray Chang
arxiv-2312-01024.description: Abstract The research explores the potential of quantum deep learning models to address challenging machine learning problems that classical deep learning models find difficult to tackle. We introduce a novel model architecture that combines classical convolutional layers with a quantum neural network, aiming to surpass state-of-the-art accuracy while maintaining a compact model size.

arxiv-2509-24399.title: Autonomous Detection and Coverage of Unknown Target Areas by Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2509-24399.creator: Jie Song
arxiv-2509-24399.description: Abstract Abstract: This paper presents a novel coverage control algorithm for multi-agent systems, where each agent has no prior knowledge of the specific region to be covered. The proposed method enables agents to autonomously detect the target area and collaboratively achieve full coverage.

arxiv-2511-15994.title: CARE-RAG - Clinical Assessment and Reasoning in RAG
arxiv-2511-15994.creator: Deepthi Potluri, Aby Mammen Mathew, Alexander L. Rasgon, Jeffrey B DeWitt, Yide Hao, Junyuan Hong, Ying Ding
arxiv-2511-15994.description: Abstract Access to the right evidence does not guarantee that large language models (LLMs) will reason with it correctly. This gap between retrieval and reasoning is especially concerning in clinical settings, where outputs must align with structured protocols. We study this gap using Written Exposure Therapy (WET) guidelines as a testbed.

pmc-10627064.title: Analysis of genome-wide 5-hydroxymethylation of blood samples stored in different anticoagulants: opportunities for the expansion of clinical resources for epigenetic research
pmc-10627064.creator: Lu Gao, Zhou Zhang, Xiao-Long Cui, Diana West-Szymanski, Chang Ye, Chuan He, Wei Zhang, Marc Bissonnette
pmc-10627064.description: Background: Elucidating epigenetic mechanisms could provide new biomarkers for disease diagnosis and prognosis. Technological advances allow genome-wide profiling of 5-hydroxymethylcytosines (5hmC) in liquid biopsies. 5hmC-Seal followed by NGS is a highly sensitive technique for 5hmC biomarker discovery in cfDNA. Currently, 5hmC Seal is optimized for EDTA blood collection.

pmc-11490630.title: A preoperative planning procedure of septal myectomy for hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy using image-based computational fluid dynamics simulations and shape optimization
pmc-11490630.creator: Zhihao Ding, Qianwen Liu, Huan Luo, Ming Yang, Yining Zhang, Shilin Wang, Yuanming Luo, Shu Chen
pmc-11490630.description: Although septal myectomy is the preferred treatment for medication-refractory hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM), the procedure remains subjective. A preoperative planning procedure is proposed using computational fluid dynamics simulations and shape optimization to assist in the objective assessment of the adequacy of the resection. 3 patients with HOCM were chosen for the application of the proposed procedure.

pmc-11522812.title: Acquired von Willebrand Disease Associated With Severe Functional Mitral Regurgitation Improved by TEER
pmc-11522812.creator: Yuki Obayashi, Shin Watanabe, Eri Toda Kato, Hiroki Shiomi, Chinatsu Yamada, Masayuki Fuki, Masahide Kawatou, Hisashi Sakaguchi, Kenji Minatoya, Koh Ono
pmc-11522812.description: A 75-year-old man with a history of small intestinal angioectasia underwent transcatheter edge-to-edge repair for severe functional mitral regurgitation, resulting in recovery of large von Willebrand Factor multimers. This case highlights the potential of transcatheter edge-to-edge repair to manage both heart failure and acquired von Willebrand disease associated with functional mitral regurgitation.

pmc-12696167.title: Inhibition of CRM1 reverses hypoxia-driven chemoresistance in acute myeloid leukemia via overcoming HIF-1α-mediated lysosomal sequestration
pmc-12696167.creator: Xiaohui Feng, Yuntian Ding, Yuling Huang, Hancheng Qin, Xiaobo Wang, Yunxin Zeng
pmc-12696167.description: IntroductionIn relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R-AML), hypoxia-driven chemoresistance is orchestrated by HIF-1α-induced P-glycoprotein (P-gp) overexpression and subsequent lysosomal sequestration of anthracyclines. Nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling of the HIF-1α prolyl-hydroxylase PHD2 is controlled by chromosome region maintenance 1 (CRM1), which is frequently up-regulated in AML; however, whether pharmacologic CRM1 inhibition restores PHD2 nuclear availability to accelerate HIF-1α degradation and reverse chemoresistance remains undefined.

pmc-13105880.title: Motivation and behavioral mechanisms of physical activity in community-dwelling elderly populations
pmc-13105880.creator: Jian Wei, Huiguo Wang
pmc-13105880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPhysical activity (PA) is essential for healthy aging, yet participation declines as older adults face interacting social, environmental, motivational, and functional barriers. Existing research rarely integrates these determinants to explain how context and capability shape PA behavior.MethodsThis study examined the mechanisms linking environmental opportunity, social support, motivation, and capability to PA among community-dwelling older adults using an integrated framework grounded in Self-Determination Theory (SDT), the COM-B model, and social-ecological principles.

pmc-13188326.title: The relationship between pregnant women’s perception of traumatic birth and their vaginal birth self-efficacy: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13188326.creator: Ebru Inan Kirmizigul, Cagla Uygun
pmc-13188326.description: BackroundWomen’s perceptions of traumatic childbirth are associated with their confidence in coping with vaginal birth. This study aimed to examine the relationship between pregnant women’s traumatic childbirth perception and their vaginal birth self-efficacy.MethodsThis cross-sectional correlational study was conducted with 152 nulliparous women attending the antenatal clinic of a private hospital in Turkey.

pmc-13260307.title: A case report of hyponatremia induced by hypopituitarism following severe traumatic brain injury and literature review
pmc-13260307.creator: Dan-Dan Liu, Shan-Shan Xu, Xu An, Yue-Fu Wang, Jian-Xin Zhou
pmc-13260307.description: Hyponatremia induced by hypopituitarism is an underrecognized complication in neurocritical care settings. This article presents a case of a patient with severe traumatic brain injury who developed euvolemic hyponatremia one month after the injury, accompanied by decreased serum osmolality. The hyponatremia remained refractory to conventional management, including fluid restriction and hypertonic saline supplementation.

pmc-13584573.title: A cluster randomized trial to evaluate the effects of a quality cluster-based intervention on the use of prostate-specific antigen test in general practice—a study protocol
pmc-13584573.creator: Pernille Hølmkjær, Christian Leick, Thomas Drivsholm, Volkert Siersma, Flemming Bro, Marius Brostrøm Kousgaard
pmc-13584573.description: BackgroundContinuous quality improvement is an important endeavor for keeping clinical practice up to date with research evidence and professional guidelines for the sake of patients and the rational use of system resources. Quality clusters are a framework for quality improvement in general practice, but the effects of working in quality clusters have not been evaluated in randomized trials.

pmc-13643542.title: The Evolving Frontier of Repeat Transcatheter Valve-in-Valve Mitral Interventions in Small Children
pmc-13643542.creator: Ming Chern Leong, Mazeni Alwi
pmc-13643542.description: Corresponding AuthorKey words: congenital heart defect, mitral valve, valve replacement Severe congenital mitral valve disease in infants and young children represents one of the most technical and clinical challenges in pediatric cardiology. The ideal solution has long been elusive because of profound anatomical constraints, the threat of patient-prosthesis mismatch from somatic growth, and the poor durability profile of conventional options.

pmc-13669494.title: Stereotactic body radiation therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma: 2026 expert consensus-based practical recommendation of the Korean Liver Cancer Association
pmc-13669494.creator: Jinhong Jung, Han Ah Lee, Do Young Kim, Hyun-Cheol Kang, Sun Hyun Bae, Ji Hye Min, Gyu Sang Yoo, Jeong Il Yu, Seo Hee Choi, Hae Lim Lee, Subin Heo, Chai Hong Rim, Sang Min Yoon, June Sung Lee, Research Committee of the Korean Liver Cancer Association
pmc-13669494.description: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) is a noninvasive, high-precision radiation technique that delivers a high dose to the tumor in a limited number of fractions, typically five or fewer, and is increasingly used as a curative-intent option for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), particularly when surgical resection, liver transplantation, or local ablative therapies are not feasible.

uslaw-usc-t36-s220506.title: 36 U.S.C. § 220506 — Exclusive right to name, seals, emblems, and badges
uslaw-usc-t36-s220506.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s220506.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 2205 (United States Olympic And Paralympic Committee); Subchapter I (Corporation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Exclusive Right of Corporation.— Except as provided in subsection (d) of this section, the corporation has the exclusive right to use— (1) the name “United States Olympic and Paralympic Committee”.
